goal_checks.notes: The viewport's page is mirrored into shared WorkspaceProvider state by the document view; PresenceProvider passes it to usePresence. PROVEN live: the teammate's rail raised 'Leader is drawing' and cleared it via the idle fallback. Before, presence was told page 0 and the check could never match a 1-based cursor page.

The listener predicate now compares sync.phase across any action, so the banner's manualOfflineSet(false) runs the cycle. PROVEN live: with the fix, Sync now pushed the queued highlight (server 5 -> 6); the pre-fix run left two ops queued with attempts 0 after the banner cleared. networkDownSet(true) also cancels the cycle now (unit).

useImportSource tries rung 1 per page and rasterizes only annotation-free pages for rung 2. PROVEN live: a generated fixture with a flattened yellow mark produced one candidate and imported a group highlight 'A flattened highlight line' (text_layer, 1.0). A pale green mark was correctly ignored by the mask's saturation threshold.
README §6, the review's §3.3 and the vault hot cache record all three; this task and todo-task-034 carry the goals and evidence.

The offline resume never ran the sync cycle (predicate keyed on the action type) — fixed; queued ops no longer stick.
Rung 2 was unmounted, so flattened-highlight documents imported nothing — fixed and proven with a fixture.

A colour-mask threshold means a pale mark is silently ignored; the review shows what was found, but a user with a very light highlighter may import nothing — record as a tuning question, not a bug.
